ana: Quick note 1 - launching Beacon next week. want a tiny PLG test: 3 arms. 1) 100 credits, 2) 100 credits + starter prompts, 3) 100 credits + starter prompts + 3 nudges. measure 7d activation + prompt reuse.

carlos: +1. keep cohort small: 900 total (300/arm). region: NA/EU. exclude existing paid orgs.

ruth: creative asks: hero image, 2 social cards, 20s demo clip. headline variants: 'Ship faster with Beacon' vs 'Starter prompts for instant demos'.

sam: experiment details: experiment_id=beacon_launch_v1, arms=[credits, prompts, prompts_nudge], primary=7d_active_pct, secondary=median_time_to_first_success_hours. will seed cohorts Tue AM.

ana: ops-bot can you schedule social post for launch day and a replay post next day? (typo: ana meant ana)

ops-bot: scheduled social post 'Beacon launch - demo + starter credits' for 2025-08-14T18:00:00Z and replay for 2025-08-15T18:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

carlos: nudges cadence proposal: Day0 email + promptpack, Day1 in-app tooltip, Day3 contextual tip, Day6 reward email with extra 50 credits if they complete 3 runs. opt-out available.

ruth: routing: tag signups beacon_launch_v1. route >10 seats to sales; others to nurture. add support alert if credit redemptions >150/hr.

sam: tracking: events = credit.grant, credit.redeem, prompt.install, quickstart.success. UTM matrix for posts. I'll add spec to the brief: https://redwood.company/s/beacon-brief

ana: next steps: ruth -> routing + webinar page, carlos -> creative by Mon EOD, sam -> cohort seed Tue AM. quick sync Tue 9am PT. thanks! :rocket:
